name: Visa assistance
short: Your student visa file checked document by document, with interview practice.

meta.title: Student visa assistance in Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Kochi
meta.description: Wayfarer checks your student visa documents against each country's official rules, helps with forms and funds, and prepares you for the visa interview. The decision belongs to the embassy.

h1: A complete, honest visa file is your best chance.
intro: We check every document against the country's official rules, help you show your funds correctly, and practise the interview with you. The embassy or immigration office makes the decision.
covers: The official document checklist for your country and visa
Proof of funds: bank statements, loan sanction letters and sponsor letters
Dependant visas for spouses and children where allowed
What to do after a refusal
whoFor: Students with an offer letter, CAS, I-20 or CoE
Families applying for a dependant visa

steps.title: Checklist
steps.text: We prepare the official checklist for your country and case.

steps.title: Funds
steps.text: We check that your money is shown in the way the rules ask.

steps.title: Forms and appointment
steps.text: We help you complete the forms and book biometrics or the interview.

steps.title: Interview practice
steps.text: Mock interviews with honest feedback, where the country has an interview.

sections.heading: No one can guarantee a visa
paragraphs: Only the embassy or immigration office decides. Anyone who promises you a visa is not being honest with you. We make sure your file is complete and true, which is what decision makers look for.

faq.q: My visa was refused. Can I apply again?
faq.a: Usually yes. Read the refusal letter carefully. We help you understand the reasons and fix what is in your control before reapplying.

faq.q: Do you help with dependant visas?
faq.a: Yes, where the country allows dependants for your course. Rules differ by country and course level.
